title: Choose the lab page structure
question: The roll assigned Instrument Bench. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Every hand hosts the demo in a 4:3 framed viewport (your pinned norm).

options.label: Instrument Bench
options.thesis: The lab page is a bench: the 4:3 screen set center-stage, corner-ticked in red, all chrome reduced to two hairline rules.
options.viewport: Two hairline rules (top: back + source; bottom: status) frame the page; the corner-ticked 4:3 viewport holds the live cube at center.
options.risk: Reads instrument-costume if the ticks decorate instead of frame.

options.label: Gallery Plate
options.lineage: hung plates in a print folio
options.thesis: The demo hangs like a plate: a double-hairline 4:3 frame, an engraved caption line beneath, and nothing else on the wall.
options.viewport: Centered double-rule 4:3 frame over a caption row (red chip, name, suffix); ghost numeral behind; status line pinned at the bottom edge.
options.risk: So quiet it could be any minimal portfolio; the caption must carry the voice.

options.label: Standing Row
options.thesis: The row you clicked never left: the lab opens with its index row standing inverted, the framed 4:3 demo beneath it.
options.viewport: Full-bleed red band (chip, name, suffix, blinking cursor, back + source) over the red-ruled 4:3 frame; status line pinned bottom.
options.risk: A full red band on load competes with the demo for first glance.
